body: Additional independently verified retained evidence for this finding: merged PR #824 (`a947a29a662f632ae2a916c3cea65595bf1da820`) already retains the exact Turkish ADM1 metadata at `data/regional-review/regional-review-c24563b50d8731b3/sources/geoboundaries-9469f09/ADM1/geoBoundaries-TUR-ADM1-metaData.json` and its parent geometry. I checked their actual bytes against the original upstream GitHub LFS pointers at `9469f09592ced973a3448cf66b6100b741b64c0d`: metadata is 791 bytes / SHA-256 `d83917dba5bcf4a54d7b07aa9c9c656becf6fd5bed7e58ddb19ea27df0d98a11`, geometry is 10,128,401 bytes / SHA-256 `01697a1722cf62db3b5f4e78ae73e7972edae52d2254ccfffa9163fc6cdbc918`. Thus the supplemental correction can cite an existing immutable merged snapshot without reading another worker’s private caches or reacquiring parent geometry. #824 uses the correct hyphenated metadata filename; it is not affected by #823’s broken citation/absence defect. The later snapshot is supporting evidence, not a correction to the historical #823 packet or proof that this follow-up is complete. No ownership, readiness or geography change is requested by this receipt.

Post-merge Auditor supplement, 2026-10-06 (America/Los_Angeles), reviewer `01a10892-0782-7b13-902c-d8b4db6c155d`; PR #880 exact merge `4215fda0a40697bbdc4f9f0a229fffe7764aac55`. The same broken TUR ADM2 metadata restoration filename is also copied into `data/regional-review/regional-review-3e1fa7fa469a0b13/source-register.json`, `/sources/0/metadata_url`. At pinned upstream commit 9469f09592ced973a3448cf66b6100b741b64c0d, authenticated GitHub contents lookup of `geoBoundaries-TUR-ADM2.metaData.json` returns 404. Complete directory enumeration and lookup of `geoBoundaries-TUR-ADM2-metaData.json` succeed; the original LFS pointer matches the actual retained metadata bytes (SHA-256 ace87195676281a6b58bc822a275646b71dbdca42ca4b7445bc928730596fdc7). This is a restoration/citation failure despite the builder succeeding with retained local/Git bytes. Expected correction: publish the exact hyphenated immutable path, commit/hash/length and successful/negative lookup controls in additive preserved evidence. Reuse this issue for the shared upstream filename defect; #874 owns the separate 30-subject packet's source/boundary context. Keep this issue's existing 222-subject contract, owned prefix and triage blockers unchanged; no worker scope is expanded. A shared metadata correction does not establish the 30 subjects' legal roles, boundaries or national completeness, and does not turn either historical audit Good. Original #880 source-register and source bytes must remain preserved.
